company.what_they_do: Atomicwork is an AI-native IT Service Management (ITSM) and Enterprise Service Management (ESM) platform. It deploys a 'Universal AI Coworker' (named Atom) that handles employee support requests — such as password resets, software access, and incident management — directly inside the tools employees already use (Microsoft Teams, Slack, browser, web portal). Rather than merely routing tickets, it resolves them end-to-end: provisioning access, installing software, managing incidents, and automating workflows across IT, HR, Finance, Legal, and other departments. It also offers voice and vision support, operates in 25+ languages, and gives different service teams private workspaces while presenting a unified experience to employees. The platform is AI-native by design (not retrofitted), built on an agentic architecture that learns organisational and employee context for smarter decisions.
raw_notes: Founded 2022; headquartered in San Francisco / Palo Alto, CA. Also has an Indian entity (ATOMICWORK SOFTWARE INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED).
Co-founders: Vijay Rayapati (CEO), Kiran Darisi (CTO), Parsuram Vijayasankar (Product Design).
Raised $40.3M total over 4 rounds, including a $25M Series A (2025). Investors include Khosla Ventures, Z47 (formerly E.Ventures), Battery Ventures, Blume Ventures, Peak XV, Storm Ventures.

Core product differentiators: agentic AI (not just chatbot), AI Coworkers with identity/skills/memory/governance, birthright access provisioning, dynamic & revoked access, multimodal support (chat, voice, vision), 25+ language support.
Integrations: Microsoft Teams, Slack, Claude, ChatGPT for Enterprise, Azure AI Foundry, Lansweeper (new partnership), Azure DevOps, Power Automate, Power BI (roadmap).
Key customer story: Zuora replaced Jira Service Management with Atomicwork across 15 global offices, achieving significant ticket volume reduction.
Other customer quotes mention replacing ServiceNow, maintaining IT team without adding headcount, ROI gains, and deploying in 6 weeks.
Head of Product: Aparna Chugh. Head of Applied AI & Platform also listed on ZoomInfo.
Competitors cited: Moveworks, Aisera, StackAI, Jira Service Management, ServiceNow.
April 2025: Launched 'Universal Agent' — multimodal AI for employee productivity.
Company tagline on homepage: 'Delightful employee support, in the flow of work.' and 'Resolutions, not just answers.'
